language_requirements.test_name: IELTS Academic (or an accepted equivalent) unless exempt
language_requirements.min_score: IELTS 7.5 overall, minimum 7.0 per component (or the equivalent threshold on an accepted alternative test), if not exempt
language_requirements.notes: Oxford's general English Language Requirement (ELR) policy (src-13), not a curriculum-specific rule for A-Level. A-Level itself is NOT listed by Oxford as an automatic exemption category. Applicants are exempt from a separate English test only if they are a native English speaker who has always been resident and a citizen of a majority English-speaking country recognised by UKVI (src-14 -- gov.uk Immigration Rules Appendix English Language, EL 4.1, which includes the UK, Ireland, and other Anglophone countries), or have been educated full-time in English for at least the two most recent years (minimum 3 years total) before applying. Most A-Level-track applicants (typically UK/Ireland-domiciled, English-medium schooled) satisfy one of these general exemptions by virtue of their schooling/residency background, not because A-Level itself is a recognised curriculum exemption. Applicants who do not qualify for an exemption must meet a standard test threshold: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall (min. 7.0 per component), TOEFL iBT 110, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 191 overall (min. 185 per component), Oxford Test of English (Advanced) 165 overall, or Pearson PTE Academic 76, by 31 July in the year of the offer.

admissions_requirements.notes: Interview: shortlisted candidates are interviewed online by at least two colleges in December; a cross-college reallocation pool operates for candidates not offered a place by their first/second-choice college. Historical 3-year average (2023-25): 21% interviewed, 7% successful, 55 places/year -- an explicitly historical statistic, never an admission-probability calculation. English-language proficiency requirements for A-Level-track applicants were not researched this run (see missing-data.json).
